F.team: F8/ We're Sexy & We Throw It

predictions: Well, it was my worst record in the last five weeks, but 17-9 was still decent last week. The worse part was that four of my nine wrong picks were not within a dart of being flipped or tied, so I really got those four kinda way wrong. But it happens. Anyway, that brings me to 160-74 (68.4% correct) for the season. I have gotten above 0.500 with all but eight teams now, and a few of those will be mine soon too! That, of course, does not include the Cheapies or Mayhem… so not included.

Match of the week: (C Div.) Nine Lives @ Mulligan's Mafia. The Pints' win over the Possee last week has created a fairly glorious four-team title chase in C. The Mafia is looking to cut it to a three-team group, while the Niners are looking to further stir the C pot. We all know I love the dramatic stories…. Alas, this one is going to the Mafia, 13-11.

Match #2: (B Div.) Wing & a Plaque @ Hump Day! After week 6, the Humpers had a two-match lead on the pack and B looked like it might end early. But all of a sudden there are four B teams within one match and a handful of points of the lead. Thus, matches within that quartet are now critical. Add in the fact that this match seems to have little bit of history to it, and this one is high drama, for sure. Wing takes 1001.

Match #3: (G Div.) Flight Club @ Shark Shooters. The Shooters' monster win over Salute last week has created a whole new world in G. These two are now only one match off the pace, and both already have the point they'll need if they can reel in Salute. Thus, this match is nearly title-fight level of importance. I'm riding the Club's DCkt prowess, 13-11.

Match #4: (D Div.) Menace 2 Sobriety @ Main Street Mayhem. Mayhem fell to the last place team last week, and all of a sudden this pairing might be an elimination match in the D title race. The Bottoms are a match and points ahead of both these squads, so there might only be time for the winner here to still make a run. Menace in 1001, again!

Match #5: (E Div.) Ton 80 Proof @ Runs with Corks. Ton 80 finally dropped one last week at the hands of Randy Warren, so the E race is back to a two-team showdown. Or could it be three if the Corks could win here and in week 14? I'll still take Ton 80, but tentatively; 13-11.

Match #6: (B Div.) Dart Attack @ Darty Little Secrets. Don't let their current positioning in 4th fool you… With their big win over the Idiots last week, a match in hand on both the Idiots and Wing, and Hump Day spiraling a bit, Attack is very much a player. DA, 14-10.

Match #7: (D Div.) Duck Fook @ Off Constantly-Reboot. Off Constantly just pulled one of their annual upsets of the division leader. Is that the start of a run that gets them out of the bottom two in D (and a possible drop to E)? I'm still feeling Ducks, 14-10.

Match #8: (A Div.) The Outlaws @ Darty Minds. Darty Minds re-announced their presence last week, and still have their sights set on a top-four finish in A (and the entire league). This one is a must-win in that scenario, and I think they'll get it. Darty time, 15-9.

Match #9: (F Div.) Sofa Kings @ Heart of Dartness. Suddenly, Dartness is one of only two undefeated teams in the entirety of the league. But they've only passed 14 points twice in 9 weeks! Is this the night they slip over the edge? Nope, but close as usual, 14-10.

Match #10: (C Div.) Pints & Points @ Darty Sanchez. The Pints got the huge win last week and are now back in the chase for the C crown. They better not blink here, as this will be tight. Pints, 13-11.
Match #11: (G Div.) Bright Side of Flights @ Double Vision. This pair is only 4-14 combined, but they only have one match between them when they didn't score 8+. That continues. Bright Side, 14-10.
Match #12: (D Div.) Lonerider @ One Dart Wonders. The two spots for those from D who will likely head to E in the spring are still very much in play. Wonders get an important win here, 14-10.
